final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.30.0, < 5.100.0"
    }
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition

  ec2_arn_prefix     = "arn:${local.partition}:ec2:${local.region}:${local.account_id}"
  efs_arn_prefix     = "arn:${local.partition}:elasticfilesystem:${local.region}:${local.account_id}"
  glacier_arn_prefix = "arn:${local.partition}:glacier:${local.region}:${local.account_id}"

  tags = {
    Project     = "GlacierEFSEC2"
    Environment = "production"
    Owner       = "TJ"
    ManagedBy   = "Terraform"
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2ReadOnlyDiscovery"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeImages",
      "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeKeyPairs",
      "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
      "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
    ]

    # These read-only EC2 API calls do not support resource-level scoping.
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EC2InstanceLifecycleManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:RebootInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:instance/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:volume/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:subnet/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:security-group/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:key-pair/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:image/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:network-interface/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EC2StorageManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:volume/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:snapshot/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:instance/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EC2SecurityGroupKeyPairAndElasticIPManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:AllocateAddress",
      "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateAddress",
      "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:security-group/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:vpc/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:key-pair/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:elastic-ip/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:instance/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EC2ResourceTagging"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:instance/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:volume/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:snapshot/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:security-group/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:key-pair/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:subnet/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:vpc/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:elastic-ip/*",
      "${local.ec2_arn_prefix}:image/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EFSClientMountAndDiscovery"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargetSecurityGroups",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.efs_arn_prefix}:file-system/*",
      "${local.efs_arn_prefix}:access-point/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierVaultAndArchiveAccess"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "glacier:CreateVault",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:ListVaults",
      "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:UploadArchive",
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:ListParts",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
    ]

    resources = [
      "${local.glacier_arn_prefix}:vaults/*",
    ]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name          = "TJ"
  path          = "/"
  force_destroy = false

  tags = merge(local.tags, {
    Name = "TJ"
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name        = "GlacierEFSEC2"
  path        = "/"
  description = "Grants EC2 management permissions, EFS client-mount access for NFS clients, and Glacier vault plus multipart-upload operations."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.glacier_efs_ec2.json

  tags = merge(local.tags, {
    Name = "GlacierEFSEC2"
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"

  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

########################################
# Static provider metadata lookups
########################################

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

########################################
# User-controlled inputs (defaults so apply is unattended)
########################################

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name used for tagging."
  type        = string
  default     = "prod"
}

variable "project" {
  description = "Project name used for tagging."
  type        = string
  default     = "iam-access-management"
}

variable "extra_tags" {
  description = "Additional user supplied tags."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name

  common_tags = merge(
    {
      Environment = var.environment
      Project     = var.project
      ManagedBy   = "terraform"

    var.extra_tags,

}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "5.99.0"
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Input variables
###############################################################################

variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "AWS account ID of the CloudHealth SaaS platform that is allowed to assume the cross-account role."
  type        = string
  default     = "123456789012"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[0-9]{12}$", var.cloudhealth_account_id))
    error_message = "cloudhealth_account_id must be a 12-digit AWS account ID."
  }
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  description = "External ID that CloudHealth must present when assuming the cross-account role. Supply via TF_VAR_cloudhealth_external_id; never commit the real value."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = "REPLACE_WITH_CLOUDHEALTH_EXTERNAL_ID"
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name applied to all taggable resources."
  type        = string
  default     = "production"
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Additional tags applied to all taggable resources."
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Provider metadata lookups (static, non-infrastructure data sources only)
###############################################################################

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

###############################################################################
# Local values
###############################################################################

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition

  common_tags = merge(var.tags, {
    Environment = var.environment
  })

  # Principal trusted to assume the role (CloudHealth's SaaS account root).
  cloudhealth_account_root_arn = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"

  # Defence-in-depth: only roles inside CloudHealth's account may assume this role.
  cloudhealth_principal_arn_pattern = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:role/*"

  # Resource-level ARNs inside the local account for actions that support them.
  scoped_read_only_resources = [
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:user/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:group/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:policy/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:instance-profile/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:mfa/*",
    "arn:${local.partition}:s3:::*",
  ]
}

###############################################################################
# Cross-account assume role policy document
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCloudHealthCrossAccountAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [local.cloudhealth_account_root_arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "ArnLike"
      variable = "aws:PrincipalArn"
      values   = [local.cloudhealth_principal_arn_pattern]
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Read-only cost and usage analysis policy document
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_read_only" {
  # Actions that do not support resource-level permissions must use Resource = "*".
  statement {
    sid    = "CostUsageReadOnlyAccountLevel"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ce:*",
      "cur:*",
      "budgets:ViewBudget",
      "budgets:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:GetDashboard",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricData",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStream",
      "cloudwatch:ListDashboards",
      "cloudwatch:ListMetrics",
      "cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource",
      "organizations:Describe*",
      "organizations:List*",
      "tag:GetResources",
      "tag:GetTagKeys",
      "tag:GetTagValues",
      "resourcegroupstaggingapi:Get*",
      "pricing:DescribeServices",
      "pricing:GetAttributeValues",
      "pricing:GetProducts",
      "account:Get*",
      "account:List*",
      "support:Describe*",
      "health:Describe*",
      "compute-optimizer:GetEnrollmentStatus",
      "compute-optimizer:GetRecommendationSummaries",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "rds:Describe*",
      "redshift:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:List*",
      "elasticache:Describe*",
      "es:Describe*",
      "es:List*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "sns:ListTopics",
      "sqs:ListQueues",
      "iam:GetAccountSummary",
      "iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy",
      "iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails",
      "iam:ListAccountAliases",
      "iam:ListUsers",
      "iam:ListRoles",
      "iam:ListGroups",
      "iam:ListPolicies",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfiles",
      "iam:ListSAMLProviders",
      "iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders",
      "iam:ListServerCertificates",
      "sts:GetCallerIdentity",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Actions that support resource-level permissions are scoped to explicit ARNs.
  statement {
    sid    = "CostUsageReadOnlyResourceLevel"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:GetRolePolicy",
      "iam:GetUser",
      "iam:GetUserPolicy",
      "iam:GetGroup",
      "iam:GetGroupPolicy",
      "iam:GetPolicy",
      "iam:GetPolicyVersion",
      "iam:GetInstanceProfile",
      "iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies",
      "iam:ListAttachedUserPolicies",
      "iam:ListAttachedGroupPolicies",
      "iam:ListRolePolicies",
      "iam:ListUserPolicies",
      "iam:ListGroupPolicies",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfilesForRole",
      "iam:ListPolicyVersions",
      "iam:ListAccessKeys",
      "iam:ListMFADevices",
      "iam:ListSigningCertificates",
      "iam:ListSSHPublicKeys",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketAcl",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicy",
      "s3:GetBucketTagging",
      "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
      "s3:GetBucketLogging",
      "s3:GetBucketNotification",
      "s3:GetBucketRequestPayment",
      "s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:GetObjectAcl",
      "s3:GetObjectTagging",
      "s3:GetObjectVersion",
      "s3:ListBucketVersions",
    ]

    resources = local.scoped_read_only_resources
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Cross-account role, customer-managed policy and attachment
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth_iam_role" {
  name                 = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  description          = "Cross-account role assumed by the CloudHealth SaaS platform with an external ID for read-only AWS cost and usage analysis."
  assume_role_policy   = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json
  max_session_duration = 43200

  tags = local.common_tags
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth_iam_policy" {
  name        = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  description = "Customer-managed read-only policy granting describe, list and get permissions across AWS services for CloudHealth cost and usage analysis."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_read_only.json

  tags = local.common_tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth_attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_iam_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_iam_policy.arn
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs (non-sensitive identifiers only)
###############################################################################

output "cloudhealth_role_name" {
  description = "Name of the CloudHealth cross-account IAM role."
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_iam_role.name
}

output "cloudhealth_role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the CloudHealth cross-account IAM role."
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_iam_role.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the customer-managed CloudHealth read-only IAM policy."
  value       = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_iam_policy.arn
}
